item.title: Why a UN committee asked India to act against hate speech and hate crimes | Explained
item.description: The UN Committee on the Elimination of Racial Discrimination (UNCERD) has raised concerns over hate speech, hate crimes, citizenship policies, and the treatment of minorities in India. The committee made several recommendations, while the Indian government rejected what it called “sweeping generalisations” in the findings.

item.title: Why Maharashtra wants to regulate coaching centres | Explained
item.description: Maharashtra’s proposed Private Coaching Centres Bill, 2026 seeks to regulate coaching institutes with new rules on admissions, fees, safety standards and student welfare. From banning school-coaching tie-ups to restricting enrolment of children below 13, here’s everything you need to know about the proposed law and its impact on students, parents and coaching centres.

item.title: Mamata Banerjee booked: FIR filed over TMCP event in Kolkata

item.title: Nepal flood miracle: Mother reunites with 8-year-old who climbed trees to survive
item.description: After a devastating glacier collapse and avalanche in Nepal, a mother believed she had lost her two sons forever. But against all odds, her 8-year-old son survived alone in the forest before being rescued and airlifted to safety, leading to an emotional reunion that has touched hearts across the country.
